words.enDefinition: A formal request to be considered for a job

examples.en: I opened my job application on the portal to finish the last two questions.
examples.zh: 我在求职门户里打开「求职申请」，继续答最后两道题。

examples.en: The library received my job application, but one of the attachments hadn't gone through.
examples.zh: 图书馆收到了我的「求职申请」，但有一个附件没传过去。

words.enDefinition: A website where applicants manage their applications

examples.en: The candidate portal shows all the applications I started with the same employer.
examples.zh: 「求职申请门户」列出了我向同一家雇主发起的所有申请。

examples.en: I signed in to the candidate portal to check whether my attachment appeared.
examples.zh: 我登录「求职申请门户」，看看附件有没有显示出来。

collocations: log in to the candidate portal

words.enDefinition: A login used to access a recruitment portal

examples.en: I created a candidate account to apply for the job at the museum.
examples.zh: 我注册了一个「求职者账户」，用来申请博物馆的工作。

examples.en: Can I use the same candidate account for openings at both university libraries?
examples.zh: 我能用同一个「求职者账户」申请两家大学图书馆的职位吗？

collocations: sign in to a candidate account

words.enDefinition: The applicant details saved in a recruitment system

examples.en: My candidate profile still shows the email address I used before graduation.
examples.zh: 我的「求职者资料」里还是毕业前用的电子邮箱地址。

examples.en: I updated my candidate profile before opening a new application at the same university.
examples.zh: 在同一所大学发起新申请之前，我先更新了「求职者资料」。

words.enDefinition: A page summarizing a candidate's applications and tasks

examples.en: The candidate dashboard showed a request for one more document when I logged in.
examples.zh: 我登录后，「求职申请总览」提示还需要补交一份材料。

examples.en: I checked my candidate dashboard to make sure both roles were listed there.
examples.zh: 我查看了「求职申请总览」，确认两个职位都列在上面。

collocations: a notification on the candidate dashboard

words.enDefinition: A link used to activate a new account

examples.en: The activation link arrived just after I registered for the university's recruitment portal.
examples.zh: 我刚在学校招聘门户注册完，就收到了「账户激活链接」。

examples.en: I requested a new activation link because the first one no longer worked.
examples.zh: 第一个「账户激活链接」失效了，我重新申请了一个。

words.enDefinition: A link that opens a job application

examples.en: The application link on the library website opened the correct job in the portal.
examples.zh: 图书馆网站的「申请入口链接」在门户中打开了对应的职位。

examples.en: I copied the application link so I could open it on my laptop later.
examples.zh: 我复制了「申请入口链接」，方便之后用笔记本打开。

words.enDefinition: A number used to identify an application

examples.en: I wrote down the application reference number while the confirmation page was still open.
examples.zh: 确认页面还开着时，我记下了「申请编号」。

examples.en: The application reference number appeared next to the title of the role I'd chosen.
examples.zh: 「申请编号」显示在我所选职位的名称旁边。

words.enDefinition: A list of steps or materials for applying

examples.en: I used the application checklist to make sure I hadn't skipped any questions.
examples.zh: 我用「申请事项清单」确认自己没有漏答任何问题。

examples.en: The application checklist includes one document I can get from the student records office.
examples.zh: 「申请事项清单」中有一份材料可以到学生档案办公室领取。

words.enDefinition: An application saved before submission

examples.en: My draft application was still there when I logged in again after class.
examples.zh: 下课后重新登录时，我的「申请草稿」还在。

examples.en: The dashboard lists the draft application under the job title I selected last week.
examples.zh: 申请总览在我上周所选的职位名称下列出了「申请草稿」。

words.enDefinition: To return to an unfinished application

examples.en: I logged in again to resume an application I had started before my shift.
examples.zh: 我重新登录，想接着「填完上班前开始写的申请」。

examples.en: Can I resume an application on another device after saving the questions I've answered?
examples.zh: 保存已答的问题后，我能换一台设备「继续填写申请」吗？

words.enDefinition: A form field that must be completed

examples.en: The portal highlighted a required field I had missed on the final page.
examples.zh: 门户高亮标出了最后一页上我漏填的一个「必填项」。

examples.en: I couldn't continue until I entered a telephone number in the required field.
examples.zh: 我在「必填项」里填上电话号码后，才能继续。

words.enDefinition: A form field that may be left empty

examples.en: The form has an optional field for names used in previous jobs or courses.
examples.zh: 表单有个填写以往工作或上课时使用的姓名的「选填项」。

examples.en: I left the optional field for a second phone number blank and continued.
examples.zh: 我把第二个电话号码的「选填项」留空，然后继续填写。

words.enDefinition: To enter nothing in a form field

examples.en: The guide says I can leave a field blank if it doesn't apply to me.
examples.zh: 指南写明，如果某一栏与我无关，可以「将这一栏留空」。

examples.en: What happens if I leave a field blank on the first page of the application?
examples.zh: 如果我在申请第一页「将某一栏留空」，会怎么样？

collocations: choose to leave a field blank
leave a field blank if it doesn't apply

words.enDefinition: A box that allows a written answer

examples.en: I used the free-text field to explain the gap between my two courses.
examples.zh: 我在「自由填写栏」里解释了两段课程之间的空档。

examples.en: The free-text field let me describe my schedule in my own words.
examples.zh: 「自由填写栏」让我能用自己的话说明时间安排。

words.enDefinition: A control that opens a list of choices

examples.en: I picked my university from a drop-down menu near the top of the page.
examples.zh: 我从页面上方的「下拉菜单」里选了自己的学校。

examples.en: The drop-down menu only offered months, so I couldn't enter an exact day.
examples.zh: 「下拉菜单」里只能选月份，所以我没法填具体日期。

collocations: an option in the drop-down menu

words.enDefinition: Choose every option that fits your situation

examples.en: The form says to select all that apply when choosing the days I can work.
examples.zh: 选择可以上班的日期时，表单提示「勾选所有适用项」。

examples.en: For the languages question, I had to select all that apply from one list.
examples.zh: 填写语言问题时，我得在列表里「勾选所有适用项」。

collocations: select all that apply to your situation

words.enDefinition: Automatic entry of previously saved information in a form

examples.en: I turned off form autofill after it entered my old address in the application.
examples.zh: 「表单自动填充」把我的旧地址填进申请后，我就把它关了。

examples.en: Form autofill saved me from entering my contact details again on the second page.
examples.zh: 有了「表单自动填充」，我不用在第二页再输入一遍联系方式。

words.enDefinition: The maximum number of characters allowed

examples.en: I shortened my answer because the application box had a character limit of five hundred.
examples.zh: 申请里的答题框「最多允许输入五百个字符」，所以我缩短了回答。

examples.en: The character limit includes spaces on this form, according to the note below the box.
examples.zh: 按输入框下方的说明，这份表单的「字符数限制」把空格也算在内。

words.enDefinition: Automatic checks on information entered in a form

examples.en: Form validation caught a missing digit in my telephone number before I could continue.
examples.zh: 我继续之前，「表单校验」发现我的电话号码少了一位。

examples.en: The portal added form validation to check whether applicants had filled in all required details.
examples.zh: 门户增加了「表单校验」，用来检查求职者是否已经填写全部必填资料。

words.enDefinition: A message showing an entry failed a check

examples.en: I got a validation error because I entered letters in the student number field.
examples.zh: 因为在学号栏输入了字母，我收到了「校验错误」提示。

examples.en: The validation error disappeared when I changed the date to the format shown below.
examples.zh: 我按下方显示的格式修改日期后，「校验错误」提示就消失了。

words.enDefinition: The form in which information must be entered

examples.en: I found the required format for dates beside the first box on the page.
examples.zh: 我在页面第一个输入框旁边找到了日期的「指定格式」。

examples.en: The required format for the document was shown beneath the upload button in small text.
examples.zh: 材料的「指定格式」用小字显示在上传按钮下面。

words.enDefinition: The current signed-in session has run out

examples.en: I saw Session expired on the screen after returning to my application after lunch.
examples.zh: 午饭后回到申请页面时，我看到屏幕提示「会话已过期」。

examples.en: The message Session expired appeared when I clicked the button to continue filling in the form.
examples.zh: 我点击按钮继续填表时，出现了「会话已过期」的提示。

words.enDefinition: Changes made but not yet stored

examples.en: The portal warned me about unsaved changes when I tried to close the tab.
examples.zh: 我准备关掉标签页时，门户提醒我还有「未保存的更改」。

examples.en: I went back because I didn't want to lose the unsaved changes to my answers.
examples.zh: 我返回上一页，因为不想丢掉答案中「未保存的更改」。

words.enDefinition: A display of a file before it is opened or submitted

examples.en: I used the file preview to check that both pages of my document were visible.
examples.zh: 我通过「文件预览」确认材料的两页都能看见。

examples.en: The file preview showed only the first page until I scrolled down inside the box.
examples.zh: 我在框内向下滚动之前，「文件预览」只显示第一页。

collocations: a thumbnail in the file preview

words.enDefinition: The formats an upload system can receive

examples.en: I checked the accepted file types before exporting my transcript from the records site.
examples.zh: 我从档案网站导出成绩单之前，先看了「支持的文件类型」。

examples.en: The help page lists the accepted file types below the instructions for uploading documents.
examples.zh: 帮助页面在材料上传说明下方列出了「支持的文件类型」。

collocations: one of the accepted file types

words.enDefinition: A file that must accompany the application

examples.en: The upload page has one required attachment and space for three optional files.
examples.zh: 上传页面有一个「必交附件」，还能加三个选交文件。

examples.en: I couldn't submit until I replaced the required attachment with a readable copy.
examples.zh: 我把那个「必交附件」换成清晰的副本后，才可以提交。

words.enDefinition: How much of a file has been uploaded

examples.en: I kept the tab open while the upload progress went from halfway to complete.
examples.zh: 「上传进度」到了一半后，我继续开着标签页，等上传完成。

examples.en: The upload progress stayed at zero until I switched to the campus Wi-Fi.
examples.zh: 我切到校园 Wi-Fi 前，「上传进度」一直是零。

words.enDefinition: The system did not finish receiving a file

examples.en: The portal displayed Upload failed just as I was about to submit the form.
examples.zh: 我正准备提交表单时，门户提示「上传失败」。

examples.en: My screen said Upload failed, but the attachment appeared when I refreshed the page.
examples.zh: 我的屏幕显示「上传失败」，但刷新后附件就出现了。

words.enDefinition: A message confirming a file upload succeeded

examples.en: I waited for the upload confirmation before moving on to the last page.
examples.zh: 我等到「上传确认通知」后，才继续到最后一页。

examples.en: The upload confirmation gave the name of each file the portal had received.
examples.zh: 「上传确认通知」列出了门户收到的每个文件名。

words.enDefinition: To see files already sent to the portal

examples.en: Where can I view uploaded files before submitting a new application on this site?
examples.zh: 在这个网站上提交新申请前，我可以在哪里「查看已上传的文件」？

examples.en: I clicked to view uploaded files and spotted a document with the wrong filename.
examples.zh: 我点击「查看已上传的文件」，发现有一份材料的文件名不对。

collocations: log in to view uploaded files
view uploaded files in the portal

words.enDefinition: An expected file that has not been included

examples.en: The portal flagged a missing attachment when I tried to review my application.
examples.zh: 我试着检查申请时，门户提示有一个「缺失的附件」。

examples.en: I added the missing attachment and checked that its filename appeared on the summary.
examples.zh: 我补上了「缺失的附件」，并确认摘要上显示了它的文件名。

collocations: a notice about a missing attachment

words.enDefinition: An attached file that cannot be read

examples.en: The portal flagged an unreadable attachment and gave me a chance to replace it.
examples.zh: 门户标出了一个「无法读取的附件」，并允许我更换。

examples.en: The department asked for a new copy after noticing an unreadable attachment in my application.
examples.zh: 部门发现我的申请里有个「无法读取的附件」后，让我再交一份副本。

words.enDefinition: To send a new file in place of another

examples.en: Can I upload a replacement file without losing my answers to the application questions?
examples.zh: 我能「上传替换文件」，同时保留申请问题的答案吗？

examples.en: I had to upload a replacement file after noticing I'd attached my older transcript.
examples.zh: 我发现自己加的是旧成绩单，只好「上传替换文件」。

collocations: choose to upload a replacement file
allow someone to upload a replacement file
upload a replacement file before submitting

words.enDefinition: A digital image made from a paper document

examples.en: I uploaded a scanned copy of the certificate I received after finishing the course.
examples.zh: 我上传了结课后收到的证书的「扫描件」。

examples.en: The scanned copy showed the seal more clearly after I adjusted the brightness.
examples.zh: 我调了亮度后，「扫描件」上的印章更清楚了。

words.enDefinition: An application filled in and delivered on paper

examples.en: The library accepted a paper application when the online form was down that afternoon.
examples.zh: 那天下午在线表单不能用，图书馆就收了「纸质申请」。

examples.en: I picked up a paper application at the front desk before my evening class.
examples.zh: 晚课前，我在前台领了一份「纸质申请」。

words.enDefinition: The part of a form asking for personal details

examples.en: The personal information section was already filled in from my previous application at the university.
examples.zh: 「个人信息栏」已自动填入我上次申请这所学校岗位时提供的信息。

examples.en: I checked the personal information section and corrected a typo in my street name.
examples.zh: 我检查了「个人信息栏」，改正了街道名里的一个错字。

collocations: details in the personal information section

words.enDefinition: The period when applications may be submitted

examples.en: The library's application window opens just after our last exams of the term.
examples.zh: 图书馆的「申请开放期」从我们这学期最后一场考试结束后开始。

examples.en: I checked the application window because the opening date fell during the holidays.
examples.zh: 我查了「申请开放期」，因为开始日期碰上了假期。

words.enDefinition: Applications accepted and handled as they arrive

examples.en: The employer accepts rolling applications and reviews forms in the order they arrive.
examples.zh: 雇主「滚动受理申请」，按表单收到的顺序审核。

examples.en: I asked whether rolling applications would continue after the next group of positions was advertised.
examples.zh: 我问下一批职位发布后，是否还会「滚动受理申请」。

words.enDefinition: To submit a request for a job electronically

examples.en: Can I apply online for the museum job from a university library computer?
examples.zh: 我能用大学图书馆的电脑「在线申请」博物馆的工作吗？

examples.en: I chose to apply online because the department's office closes before my last class.
examples.zh: 我选择「在线申请」，因为最后一节课还没结束，部门办公室就关门了。

words.enDefinition: Currently open for people to submit applications

examples.en: The jobs page says “Now accepting applications” under the heading for weekend library roles.
examples.zh: 招聘页面在图书馆周末岗位的标题下写着「现已开始受理申请」。

examples.en: I saw “Now accepting applications” beside the vacancy I had been waiting to open.
examples.zh: 我在一直等着开放的职位旁看到「现已开始受理申请」。

collocations: now accepting applications for summer jobs

words.enDefinition: Applications are no longer being accepted

examples.en: The portal said Applications are closed even though the original listing was still visible.
examples.zh: 尽管还看得到原来的招聘信息，门户还是提示「申请已关闭」。

examples.en: I went back the next morning and found Applications are closed on the job page.
examples.zh: 第二天早上再打开职位页面时，我看到了「申请已关闭」。

collocations: a message saying applications are closed
applications are closed for this role

words.enDefinition: A question used to assess applicants at first

examples.en: One screening question asked whether I could work at both branches of the library.
examples.zh: 有一道「初筛问题」问我能不能在图书馆两家分馆工作。

examples.en: I read each screening question carefully before selecting my answer from the list.
examples.zh: 我仔细读完每道「初筛问题」，才从列表里选答案。

words.enDefinition: A screening question with an answer that rules someone out

examples.en: The recruiter explained how a knockout question could rule someone out before a manual review.
examples.zh: 招聘人员解释，「一票否决式筛选题」可能在人工审核之前就淘汰申请者。

examples.en: The workshop distinguished a knockout question from questions used only to collect information.
examples.zh: 工作坊区分了「一票否决式筛选题」和只用于收集信息的问题。

words.enDefinition: The soonest date someone is available to begin

examples.en: I entered my earliest start date after checking when my final exam would finish.
examples.zh: 确认最后一场考试什么时候结束后，我填写了「最早可到岗日期」。

examples.en: The portal asked for my earliest start date in the section about my availability.
examples.zh: 门户在询问我什么时候有空的那一栏里，要求填写「最早可到岗日期」。

words.expression: how did you hear about us
words.lemma: how did you hear about us
words.enDefinition: Asking where someone learned about the organization
acceptedEnVariants: how did you hear about us

examples.en: The question “How did you hear about us?” appeared at the end of the application.
examples.zh: 申请表最后出现了「您是怎么知道我们的」这个问题。

examples.en: I chose “University job board” when the form asked “How did you hear about us?”
examples.zh: 表单问「您是怎么知道我们的」时，我选了学校招聘信息板。

collocations: answer “How did you hear about us?”
a field labelled “How did you hear about us?”
a response to “How did you hear about us?”

words.enDefinition: A formal statement an applicant confirms as true

examples.en: The applicant declaration asked me to confirm that the information I had entered was accurate.
examples.zh: 「申请人声明」要求我确认已填写的信息准确无误。

examples.en: I read the applicant declaration before ticking the box at the bottom of the page.
examples.zh: 我先读了「申请人声明」，然后才勾选页面底部的方框。

words.enDefinition: A statement revealing interests that could affect impartiality

examples.en: The museum asked for a conflict-of-interest disclosure from everyone applying to join the project.
examples.zh: 博物馆要求每位申请加入项目的人填写「利益冲突申报」。

examples.en: I checked the instructions beside the conflict-of-interest disclosure before completing that section of the form.
examples.zh: 填写表单那一栏之前，我看了「利益冲突申报」旁边的说明。

words.enDefinition: Permission for an organization to handle personal information

examples.en: The form asked for consent to data processing before I entered my employment history.
examples.zh: 我填工作经历之前，表单要求我「同意处理个人数据」。

examples.en: The consent to data processing was recorded on the last page of my application.
examples.zh: 我的申请最后一页记录了「个人数据处理授权」。

words.enDefinition: An explanation of how applicants' information is used

examples.en: I read the recruitment privacy notice before deciding which optional details to include.
examples.zh: 我先读了「招聘隐私通知」，再决定填写哪些选填信息。

examples.en: The recruitment privacy notice explains which information is shared with the hiring panel.
examples.zh: 「招聘隐私通知」说明了哪些信息会与招聘小组共享。

collocations: a link to the recruitment privacy notice

words.enDefinition: The length of time information is kept

examples.en: The notice listed a different data retention period for applicants who joined the talent pool.
examples.zh: 通知对加入人才库的求职者列出了不同的「数据保留期限」。

examples.en: I checked the data retention period before choosing whether to keep my profile active.
examples.zh: 决定是否继续保留有效资料之前，我查了「数据保留期限」。

words.expression: opt in to a talent pool
words.lemma: opt in to a talent pool
words.enDefinition: To agree to be considered for future openings
acceptedEnVariants: opt in to a talent pool

examples.en: The final page asked whether I wanted to opt in to a talent pool.
examples.zh: 最后一页询问我是否想「主动加入人才库」。

examples.en: Did you opt in to a talent pool when you applied to the university?
examples.zh: 申请学校的岗位时，你有没有「主动选择加入人才库」？

collocations: choose to opt in to a talent pool
invite applicants to opt in to a talent pool
decline to opt in to a talent pool

words.enDefinition: Collection of information to assess fairness in recruitment

examples.en: The equal opportunities monitoring section was on a separate page from my application answers.
examples.zh: 「平等就业机会监测」栏和申请问题的答案分在不同页面。

examples.en: I asked who could see the information collected for equal opportunities monitoring on this form.
examples.zh: 我问谁能看到这份表单为「平等就业机会监测」收集的信息。

collocations: collect data for equal opportunities monitoring

words.enDefinition: Sharing information that is not required

examples.en: The form described the questions about personal background as voluntary disclosure in a separate note.
examples.zh: 这份表单单独注明，个人背景问题属于「自愿披露」。

examples.en: I asked whether voluntary disclosure meant I could skip the section and still continue.
examples.zh: 我问「自愿披露」是否意味着我可以跳过这一栏继续。

words.enDefinition: An option to decline answering a question

examples.en: I selected Prefer not to say on one of the optional questions in the form.
examples.zh: 我在表单的一道选答题上选了「不愿透露」。

examples.en: The button labelled Prefer not to say was at the bottom of the list.
examples.zh: 标为「不愿透露」的按钮在列表最下方。

collocations: a prefer not to say option

words.enDefinition: A form for reporting one's own demographic information

examples.en: The self-identification form appeared separately from the questions about my education and work history.
examples.zh: 「个人背景自报表」和教育及工作经历的问题分开显示。

examples.en: I checked whether the self-identification form could be left blank on the candidate portal.
examples.zh: 我查看了「个人背景自报表」能否在求职门户上留空。

words.enDefinition: To ask for a change addressing an access need

examples.en: The portal explains how to request an adjustment when filling in the online form.
examples.zh: 求职门户说明了填写在线表单时如何「申请无障碍调整」。

examples.en: I wanted to request an adjustment because the document viewer didn't work with my screen reader.
examples.zh: 材料查看器和我的屏幕阅读器不兼容，所以我想「申请无障碍调整」。

collocations: request an adjustment for an assessment
a way to request an adjustment

words.enDefinition: Directions for completing and sending an application

examples.en: The application instructions explained which documents could be uploaded after the form was submitted.
examples.zh: 「申请填写说明」写明了哪些材料可以在提交表单后再上传。

examples.en: I reread the application instructions because I wasn't sure how to enter my degree.
examples.zh: 我不确定学位该怎么填写，所以又看了一遍「申请填写说明」。

words.enDefinition: Information about someone who can provide a reference

examples.en: I checked my referee details before saving the last page of the form.
examples.zh: 保存表单的最后一页之前，我核对了「推荐人资料」。

examples.en: The portal asked for referee details but let me add them at a later stage.
examples.zh: 求职门户要求填写「推荐人资料」，但允许我之后再填。

words.enDefinition: Permission for an employer to contact one's references

examples.en: The last page asked for reference check consent before the full application could be submitted.
examples.zh: 提交完整申请之前，最后一页要求我「同意核查推荐信息」。

examples.en: I read the reference check consent section carefully to see what it covered.
examples.zh: 我仔细读了「推荐信息核查授权」那一栏，看看核查范围是什么。

words.enDefinition: A question asking if someone may legally work

examples.en: The work authorization question appeared on a separate page from the previous employment section.
examples.zh: 「工作许可问题」和以往工作经历那一栏分在不同页面。

examples.en: I read the note under the work authorization question before choosing an answer.
examples.zh: 选择答案前，我先读了「工作许可问题」下方的说明。

collocations: a work authorization question on the form

words.enDefinition: A page showing entries so they can be checked

examples.en: I spotted the wrong phone number on the review screen and went back to edit it.
examples.zh: 我在「提交前核对页面」发现电话号码不对，就返回去改了。

examples.en: The review screen showed my answers and the names of the documents I had attached.
examples.zh: 「提交前核对页面」显示了我的答案和所附材料的文件名。

words.enDefinition: Complete and prepared to be sent

examples.en: My application looked ready to submit after I checked the names on both attachments.
examples.zh: 核对两个附件的文件名后，我的申请看起来「可以提交了」。

examples.en: The portal marked my application as ready to submit once I answered the last question.
examples.zh: 我答完最后一道题后，门户把我的申请标为「可以提交」。

collocations: check whether a form is ready to submit
mark an application as ready to submit

words.enDefinition: The last action sending a completed application

examples.en: The system lets me change my answers right up until final submission of the form.
examples.zh: 在表单「最终提交」之前，系统一直允许我修改答案。

examples.en: I asked whether final submission would prevent me from updating my phone number later.
examples.zh: 我问「最终提交」后会不会无法更新电话号码。

words.enDefinition: To approve sending an application when prompted

examples.en: The portal asked me to confirm submission after I checked the name and job title.
examples.zh: 我核对姓名和职位名称后，门户让我「确认提交」。

examples.en: Do I need to confirm submission again after going back to change one answer?
examples.zh: 返回去修改一个答案之后，我需要再次「确认提交」吗？

words.enDefinition: To send application materials by email

examples.en: The library said I could submit by email if the attachment page stopped working.
examples.zh: 图书馆说，如果附件页面无法使用，我可以「通过电子邮件提交」。

examples.en: I asked whether I could submit by email or had to use the portal.
examples.zh: 我问能不能「通过电子邮件提交」，还是必须用求职门户。

collocations: allow applicants to submit by email

words.enDefinition: A message showing that a submission went through

examples.en: I waited for the submission confirmation before closing the tab on my phone.
examples.zh: 我等到「提交确认通知」后，才关掉手机上的标签页。

examples.en: The submission confirmation showed the role, the date and the name of the department.
examples.zh: 「提交确认通知」列出了职位、日期和部门名称。

words.enDefinition: The exact date and time a submission was recorded

examples.en: My submission timestamp showed that the form went through just before the page closed.
examples.zh: 我的「提交时间戳」显示，表单在页面关闭前不久就送达了。

examples.en: I compared the submission timestamp with the time shown in my confirmation message.
examples.zh: 我对照了「提交时间戳」和确认消息里的时间。

collocations: a submission timestamp on the confirmation

words.enDefinition: The system did not accept or finish the submission

examples.en: The message Submission failed appeared even though I had filled in every required field.
examples.zh: 尽管我填了所有必填项，系统还是提示「提交失败」。

examples.en: I saw Submission failed and checked whether a copy of my answers was still saved.
examples.zh: 我看到「提交失败」，就查看回答有没有保存副本。

words.enDefinition: To save a copy to one's device

examples.en: I clicked to download a copy of the completed application for my own records.
examples.zh: 我点了「下载一份副本」，把填好的申请留档。

examples.en: Can I download a copy of my answers before I submit the form?
examples.zh: 提交表单前，我能「下载一份回答的副本」吗？

collocations: allow applicants to download a copy
download a copy for your records

words.enDefinition: A list of a user's past applications

examples.en: I found my spring application in the application history after signing in again.
examples.zh: 重新登录后，我在「申请历史记录」里找到了春季提交的申请。

examples.en: My application history shows the two library roles I applied for last year.
examples.zh: 我的「申请历史记录」显示了去年申请的两个图书馆职位。

collocations: an entry in your application history

words.enDefinition: To revise information in an existing application

examples.en: Can you update your application if you change your address during the recruitment process?
examples.zh: 如果在招聘期间搬家，还能「更新你的申请资料」吗？

examples.en: The portal lets you update your application until the employer begins reviewing it.
examples.zh: 雇主开始审核之前，你可以在求职门户上「更新申请资料」。

collocations: log in to update your application
update your application before the deadline

words.enDefinition: To change an application that has already been sent

examples.en: The portal lets me edit a submitted application until the hiring team opens it.
examples.zh: 招聘小组打开申请前，我可以在门户「修改已提交的申请」。

examples.en: Can I edit a submitted application if I realise I entered the wrong telephone number?
examples.zh: 如果发现电话号码输错了，我还能「修改已提交的申请」吗？

collocations: allow someone to edit a submitted application
log in to edit a submitted application
ask to edit a submitted application

words.enDefinition: Documents requested beyond those already submitted

examples.en: The dashboard showed a request for additional documents after the first review of my application.
examples.zh: 我的申请初审后，申请总览提示需要「补交材料」。

examples.en: I sent the additional documents through the portal and checked that both appeared in the list.
examples.zh: 我通过门户「补交了材料」，并确认两份都显示在列表里。

words.enDefinition: A message asking an applicant for a document

examples.en: The document request listed the course certificate I had forgotten to upload the first time.
examples.zh: 「材料提交请求」列出了我第一次忘记上传的课程证书。

examples.en: I opened the document request to find out where to upload the file.
examples.zh: 我打开「材料提交请求」，查看该在哪里上传文件。

words.enDefinition: Sent back so that errors can be fixed

examples.en: The portal marked my application as Returned for correction after finding a date mismatch.
examples.zh: 求职门户发现日期不一致后，将我的申请标为「已退回待更正」。

examples.en: One application was returned for correction because a required page had been left blank.
examples.zh: 一份申请由于必填页面留空，「被退回待更正」。

collocations: mark a submission as returned for correction

words.enDefinition: The last time a corrected application may be sent

examples.en: The resubmission deadline appeared at the top of my application after it was returned.
examples.zh: 申请被退回后，「重新提交截止时间」显示在申请顶部。

examples.en: I checked the resubmission deadline before asking the student records office for another copy.
examples.zh: 向学生档案办公室再要一份副本前，我先查看了「重新提交截止时间」。

words.enDefinition: To send an existing application again

examples.en: Can I resubmit an application after replacing the document that the department couldn't open?
examples.zh: 更换部门打不开的文件后，我可以「重新提交申请」吗？

examples.en: The portal gave me one day to resubmit an application with the corrected certificate.
examples.zh: 门户给了我一天时间，让我用更正后的证书「重新提交申请」。

collocations: give someone time to resubmit an application
be able to resubmit an application

words.enDefinition: To apply for the same job on another occasion

examples.en: Can I reapply for a role if it opens again in the new term?
examples.zh: 如果同一个职位下学期重新开放，我能「再次申请」吗？

examples.en: I decided to reapply for a role at the museum when it was advertised again.
examples.zh: 博物馆重新发布这个职位时，我决定「再次申请」。

collocations: choose to reapply for a role
wait to reapply for a role
be allowed to reapply for a role

words.enDefinition: To take an application out of consideration

examples.en: I decided to withdraw an application after finding out the shifts clashed with my classes.
examples.zh: 发现班次和课表冲突后，我决定「撤回申请」。

examples.en: The portal explained how to withdraw an application without deleting the whole candidate account.
examples.zh: 求职门户说明了如何「撤回申请」并保留求职者账户。

words.enDefinition: Another application from the same person for the same vacancy

examples.en: The dashboard flagged a duplicate application when I clicked the old link by mistake.
examples.zh: 我误点了旧链接，申请总览提示有一份「重复申请」。

examples.en: The employer only reviewed the first submission and marked the second as a duplicate application.
examples.zh: 雇主只审核了第一份提交的材料，把第二份标为「重复申请」。

words.enDefinition: An application can no longer be edited

examples.en: The portal showed Application locked when the department started reviewing forms on Monday.
examples.zh: 部门周一开始审核表单时，求职门户显示「申请已锁定」。

examples.en: I saw Application locked when I tried to replace a file after the deadline.
examples.zh: 截止后我尝试更换文件时，看到「申请已锁定」。

words.enDefinition: To make a closed application active again

examples.en: The administrator offered to reopen an application after confirming that the upload had failed.
examples.zh: 确认上传失败后，管理员提出可以「重新开放这份申请」。

examples.en: I asked whether the department could reopen an application so I could correct one answer.
examples.zh: 我问部门能不能「重新开放申请」，让我改一道题的答案。

words.enDefinition: An inactive application has been moved into storage

examples.en: The portal showed Application archived beside the library job I applied for last year.
examples.zh: 在我去年申请的图书馆职位旁边，求职门户显示「申请已归档」。

examples.en: I saw Application archived on the old form but could still open a copy.
examples.zh: 旧表单上显示「申请已归档」，但我还能打开副本。

words.enDefinition: An employer's system has recorded the application

examples.en: The dashboard showed Application received beside the role I'd applied for that morning.
examples.zh: 申请总览在我当天上午申请的职位旁显示「申请已收到」。

examples.en: I took a screenshot when the portal displayed Application received after I refreshed it.
examples.zh: 刷新后，门户显示「申请已收到」，我就截了图。

collocations: show application received on the dashboard

words.enDefinition: The employer is currently evaluating an application

examples.en: The portal changed to Application under review two days after the deadline for the role.
examples.zh: 该职位截止两天后，门户状态变成了「申请正在审核」。

examples.en: I saw Application under review beside the vacancy when I checked the portal on Friday.
examples.zh: 我周五查看求职门户时，职位旁显示「申请正在审核」。

collocations: mark an application as under review

words.enDefinition: A status showing documents are still needed

examples.en: The application stayed at Awaiting documents while I waited for an official transcript.
examples.zh: 我在等正式成绩单时，申请一直显示「等待补交材料」。

examples.en: The portal showed Awaiting documents beside the role until my revised certificate went through.
examples.zh: 我更正后的证书上传成功之前，门户一直在职位旁显示「等待补交材料」。

collocations: mark a submission as awaiting documents

words.enDefinition: A notice that the applicant must do something

examples.en: I saw Action required beside my application after opening it on my laptop.
examples.zh: 我用笔记本打开申请后，在它旁边看到了「需要操作」。

examples.en: The dashboard showed Action required because I still needed to confirm my preferred test date.
examples.zh: 我还要确认想选的测试日期，所以申请总览显示「需要操作」。

words.enDefinition: The first review used to narrow down applicants

examples.en: My application went through initial screening before I was asked to take a short test.
examples.zh: 我的申请先经过了「初步筛选」，之后我才被要求做一个简短的测试。

examples.en: The portal says initial screening starts once the employer stops accepting new applications.
examples.zh: 求职门户说明，雇主停止接收新申请后就会开始「初步筛选」。

words.enDefinition: A check that an applicant meets minimum requirements

examples.en: The eligibility check looked at whether I would still be enrolled next term.
examples.zh: 「申请资格核查」查的是我下学期是否仍然在读。

examples.en: I was asked for proof of enrolment so the team could complete the eligibility check.
examples.zh: 对方让我提供在读证明，以便招聘组完成「申请资格核查」。

words.enDefinition: Software-based filtering of applications

examples.en: The workshop described how automated screening can flag applications with unanswered questions.
examples.zh: 工作坊介绍了「自动筛选」如何标出有未答问题的申请。

examples.en: The employer uses automated screening before its staff review the remaining applications.
examples.zh: 该雇主先用「自动筛选」，再由员工审核剩余申请。

words.enDefinition: Checking an application by a person

examples.en: The form went to manual review after the system couldn't match my course code.
examples.zh: 系统没能匹配我的课程代码，所以表单转入了「人工审核」。

examples.en: I was told which documents would be checked as part of the manual review.
examples.zh: 对方告诉我，「人工审核」会核查哪些材料。

collocations: send an application for manual review

words.enDefinition: The result of an initial assessment of an application

examples.en: The screening outcome appeared in the portal before I received any further instructions.
examples.zh: 我还没收到后续说明，「筛选结果」就已经显示在门户里了。

examples.en: I checked whether the screening outcome listed a reason or just the next step.
examples.zh: 我看了「筛选结果」有没有写明原因，还是只列出下一步。

words.enDefinition: All people being considered for a particular opening

examples.en: The applicant pool included students from three universities with similar library training programmes.
examples.zh: 「应聘者群体」包括三所大学的学生，这些学校都有类似的图书馆培训项目。

examples.en: The report described the applicant pool without showing anyone's name or personal details.
examples.zh: 报告描述了「应聘者群体」的情况，没有显示任何人的姓名或个人资料。

words.enDefinition: Selecting a smaller group for closer consideration

examples.en: Shortlisting began after the last batch of applications arrived on the closing date.
examples.zh: 截止当天最后一批申请送达后，开始了「筛选入围人选」的工作。

examples.en: The university listed a week for shortlisting before the next stage was due.
examples.zh: 大学在下一阶段预定开始前安排了一周「筛选入围人选」。

words.enDefinition: Selected to be considered further from a larger group

examples.en: The portal showed I was shortlisted along with other applicants for the campus job.
examples.zh: 门户显示，我和其他几位求职者一起「入围」了这个校园岗位。

examples.en: I wasn't shortlisted for the first role, but the second was still under review.
examples.zh: 我没「入围」第一个岗位，但第二个岗位的申请还在审核中。

words.enDefinition: A group of candidates an employer may consider later

examples.en: The recruiter kept my details in a talent pool for future openings at other branches.
examples.zh: 招聘人员把我的资料留在「人才储备库」里，以备其他分店今后有空缺。

examples.en: The employer asked whether I wanted to stay in its talent pool after this hiring round.
examples.zh: 这轮招聘后，雇主问我是否希望继续留在他们的「人才储备库」里。

words.enDefinition: One step in the process of evaluating an application

examples.en: The dashboard shows the current application stage for each role I have applied for.
examples.zh: 申请总览显示了我所申请每个职位当前的「申请流程阶段」。

examples.en: I asked whether the application stage shown online changed immediately after the team reviewed documents.
examples.zh: 我问招聘组审核材料之后，网上显示的「申请流程阶段」是否会马上更新。

collocations: advance to the next application stage

words.enDefinition: To be allowed to continue in a selection process

examples.en: I had to upload a clear certificate before I could move to the next stage.
examples.zh: 我得先上传一份清晰的证书，才能「进入下一阶段」。

examples.en: The dashboard told me I could move to the next stage after the initial review.
examples.zh: 申请总览提示我，初审后可以「进入下一阶段」。

collocations: be invited to move to the next stage
move to the next stage of recruitment
be ready to move to the next stage

words.enDefinition: Progress on an application is temporarily paused

examples.en: The dashboard showed Application on hold while the employer checked the staffing plans.
examples.zh: 雇主核对人员安排期间，申请总览显示「申请暂缓处理」。

examples.en: I asked what Application on hold meant for the library role I had applied for.
examples.zh: 我问申请的图书馆职位显示「申请暂缓处理」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: The employer has found someone for the role

examples.en: The original page displayed Vacancy filled when I checked the listing on the weekend.
examples.zh: 我周末查看招聘信息时，原页面显示「职位已招到人」。

examples.en: I saw Vacancy filled beside the library role even though my application still appeared.
examples.zh: 虽然还看得到我的申请，但图书馆职位旁已经显示「职位已招到人」。

collocations: mark a listing as vacancy filled

words.enDefinition: Recruitment for a position has been called off

examples.en: The portal showed Role cancelled after the department changed its plans for the summer.
examples.zh: 部门调整暑期计划后，求职门户显示「岗位招聘已取消」。

examples.en: I read Role cancelled next to one of the roles on my candidate dashboard.
examples.zh: 我在申请总览的一个职位旁看到了「岗位招聘已取消」。

words.enDefinition: Not chosen to proceed or receive the role

examples.en: The dashboard showed Not selected for the spring intake after the screening results came out.
examples.zh: 筛选结果出来后，申请总览显示我在春季招聘中「未获选」。

examples.en: I saw Not selected on one application, while the other one was still active.
examples.zh: 我看到一份申请显示「未获选」，另一份仍在处理中。

collocations: a candidate not selected for a role
mark an applicant as not selected

words.enDefinition: An application has been taken out of consideration

examples.en: The portal displayed Application withdrawn after I confirmed I could not work those shifts.
examples.zh: 我确认无法上那些班次后，求职门户显示「申请已撤回」。

examples.en: Application withdrawn appeared on my dashboard, but the original form was still visible.
examples.zh: 申请总览提示「申请已撤回」，但原来的表单仍然可见。

collocations: an application withdrawn by the candidate

words.enDefinition: A list of candidates who may be considered later

examples.en: The notification said I was on the reserve list for the library assistant role.
examples.zh: 通知说我在图书馆助理职位的「候补名单」上。

examples.en: I asked whether the reserve list applied to future openings or only this vacancy.
examples.zh: 我问「候补名单」也适用于将来的空缺，还是只适用于这个岗位。

collocations: be placed on a reserve list
select someone from a reserve list

words.enDefinition: A request to take an assessment

examples.en: An assessment invitation appeared on my dashboard after the hiring team reviewed my application.
examples.zh: 招聘小组审核申请后，我的申请总览上出现了「测评邀请」。

examples.en: I opened the assessment invitation to check which dates were available that week.
examples.zh: 我打开「测评邀请」，看看那周有哪些日期可以选。

words.enDefinition: A test used to evaluate someone before hiring

examples.en: The pre-employment assessment included a short exercise based on tasks at the library.
examples.zh: 「录用前测评」包括一项以图书馆工作为背景的简短练习。

examples.en: I checked the device requirements before opening the pre-employment assessment on my laptop.
examples.zh: 用笔记本打开「录用前测评」之前，我先查看了设备要求。

words.enDefinition: The last time an assessment can be submitted

examples.en: The assessment deadline appeared next to the invitation on my dashboard on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五，我的申请总览在邀请旁显示了「测评截止时间」。

examples.en: I checked the time zone listed beside the assessment deadline before starting the test.
examples.zh: 开始测试前，我查看了「测评截止时间」旁标注的时区。

words.enDefinition: An assessment that has a fixed time limit

examples.en: I chose a quiet computer room before starting the timed assessment for the library role.
examples.zh: 开始图书馆职位的「限时测评」前，我选了一间安静的机房。

examples.en: The timed assessment showed how many minutes I had left in the top corner.
examples.zh: 「限时测评」页面上方的角落里显示了还剩多少分钟。

words.enDefinition: A sample assessment for getting used to the format

examples.en: I did the practice assessment to see how the page showed each question.
examples.zh: 我做了「模拟测评」，看看页面是怎么展示每道题的。

examples.en: The employer said the practice assessment would not appear in my application record.
examples.zh: 雇主说，「模拟测评」不会记入我的申请记录。

words.enDefinition: A period in which a test may be taken

examples.en: The test window opens on Monday and closes before the end of the week.
examples.zh: 「测试开放时段」从周一开始，在本周结束前截止。

examples.en: I checked the test window so I could choose a day without classes.
examples.zh: 我查了「测试开放时段」，这样能选一天没课的时间。

words.enDefinition: A link giving access to an assessment

examples.en: The assessment link opened a welcome screen with the instructions for the test.
examples.zh: 「测评入口链接」打开的是一个带有测试说明的欢迎页面。

examples.en: I couldn't open the assessment link on my phone, so I used my laptop.
examples.zh: 手机上打不开「测评入口链接」，所以我改用了笔记本。

words.enDefinition: Directions for taking and completing an assessment

examples.en: The assessment instructions explained where to find the timer after opening the test.
examples.zh: 「测评说明」解释了打开测试后去哪里找计时器。

examples.en: I read the assessment instructions before clicking the button to begin on my laptop.
examples.zh: 我先读了「测评说明」，然后才在笔记本上按下开始按钮。

words.enDefinition: Information about how someone performed on an assessment

examples.en: The portal displayed my assessment results alongside the status of my application for the role.
examples.zh: 门户把我的「测评结果」和该职位的申请状态列在一起。

examples.en: I could see my assessment results, but the recruitment team was still reviewing my documents.
examples.zh: 我已经能看到「测评结果」，但招聘小组还在审核我的材料。

words.enDefinition: A test using an example of tasks from the role

examples.en: The work sample test asked me to sort a short set of library records.
examples.zh: 「工作样例测试」让我整理一小组图书馆记录。

examples.en: I read the instructions for the work sample test before starting the cataloguing exercise.
examples.zh: 开始编目练习前，我先读了「工作样例测试」的说明。

words.enDefinition: An exercise recreating situations from a particular job

examples.en: The job simulation asked what I would do when two visitors needed help at once.
examples.zh: 「岗位情境模拟」问我，如果两位访客同时需要帮助，我会怎么办。

examples.en: I could see the instructions for the job simulation before the countdown started.
examples.zh: 倒计时开始前，我可以看到「岗位情境模拟」的说明。

collocations: take part in a job simulation

words.enDefinition: The lowest score needed to pass an assessment

examples.en: The assessment page explained the minimum passing score before we started the practice questions.
examples.zh: 开始做练习题之前，测评页面说明了「最低通过分数」。

examples.en: I asked whether the same minimum passing score applied to both parts of the test.
examples.zh: 我问测试的两个部分是否采用相同的「最低通过分数」。

words.enDefinition: There has been no change in the recorded status

examples.en: I saw Status unchanged when I opened the dashboard after the document review.
examples.zh: 材料审核后，我打开申请总览，看到了「状态未变」。

examples.en: Uploading the revised copy of my certificate left the status unchanged on the portal.
examples.zh: 我上传了更正后的证书副本，但求职门户里的「状态未变」。

words.enDefinition: A stored entry showing that materials were sent

examples.en: I opened the submission record to check that both attachments had gone through.
examples.zh: 我打开「提交记录」，确认两个附件都提交成功了。

examples.en: The submission record listed the day I sent the revised form to the department.
examples.zh: 「提交记录」列出了我向部门提交修订表单的日期。

collocations: a submission record for an application

words.enDefinition: To send more information requested for an application

examples.en: The department gave me until Friday to submit additional information about my degree course.
examples.zh: 部门让我在周五之前「补交关于学位课程的信息」。

examples.en: Can I submit additional information through the candidate portal after the initial review?
examples.zh: 初审后，我能通过求职门户「补交信息」吗？

collocations: ask an applicant to submit additional information
submit additional information before the deadline

words.enDefinition: A copy that can be viewed without making changes

examples.en: I could open a read-only copy of my application after the employer closed the form.
examples.zh: 雇主关闭表单后，我还能打开申请的「只读副本」。

examples.en: The read-only copy included the answers I had submitted but did not allow changes.
examples.zh: 「只读副本」包含我提交的答案，但无法修改。

words.enDefinition: Applications waiting to be processed

examples.en: The department said my form was still in the application queue after the holiday.
examples.zh: 部门说，假期结束后，我的表单仍在「待处理申请队列」中。

examples.en: The portal showed when my form had been added to the application queue.
examples.zh: 求职门户显示了我的表单什么时候加入「待处理申请队列」。

collocations: an application still in the queue

words.enDefinition: Label introducing the date something was submitted

examples.en: The dashboard showed Submitted on Friday next to the form for the evening job.
examples.zh: 晚班职位的表单旁，申请总览显示「提交于」周五。

examples.en: I copied the date next to Submitted on because the confirmation message had disappeared.
examples.zh: 确认通知找不到了，我就抄下了「提交于」旁边的日期。

collocations: the value next to submitted on

words.enDefinition: Evidence an applicant has to supply

examples.en: The portal listed the required supporting evidence beside the eligibility questions on the first page.
examples.zh: 求职门户在第一页的资格问题旁列出了「必交证明材料」。

examples.en: I checked which documents counted as required supporting evidence before contacting the records office.
examples.zh: 联系档案办公室前，我查了哪些文件可以作为「必交证明材料」。

words.enDefinition: A stated reason an application was not accepted

examples.en: The portal didn't display a rejection reason for the position at the campus library.
examples.zh: 求职门户没有显示这个校园图书馆职位的「申请被拒原因」。

examples.en: I saw a rejection reason next to my application after the initial screening ended.
examples.zh: 初筛结束后，我在申请旁边看到了「申请被拒原因」。
